ImageDescription.value: Cannons on the terrace of the Castillo de Santa Rosa at La Asunción, above the valley. La Asunción, Margarita Island, Nueva Esparta, Venezuela. The castle was begun on 24 March 1677 by order of the governor Juan Muñoz de Gadea, after French corsairs sacked La Asunción, and finished about 1683. Luisa Cáceres de Arismendi was held in one of its cells from November 1815 to January 1816, to force the surrender of her husband Juan Bautista Arismendi.
